verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a dedicated Editor API for automating and extending the Editor, covering scene manipulation, asset management and custom tool integration (docs-30, docs-9, docs-34). It also ships an official, npm-published Editor MCP server that modifies project data programmatically (docs-6, probe-rt-1), plus PCUI, the component library the Editor itself is built with, for building browser-based tools (docs-23). missing for 10: a documented plugin packaging/loading and distribution mechanism for editor extensions, and independent hands-on corroboration of how deep the Editor API goes.
